planets.name: K2-216 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-216 with a 2.17-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-216 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-216. Its orbit and size follow Persson et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
